question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

It was a **__perilous__** journey.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Dangerous.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word** Perilous** means full of danger or risk. **(जोखिम भरा/ख़तरनाक)**

 
 
• **Example:-** *The economy is in a** perilous__** state.*
 
 
 
• The word** Dangerous **means able or likely to cause harm or injury. **(ख़तरनाक)**
 __
 
• **Example:- ***It is **dangerous**__ to convict on his evidence.*
 
 
 
• As both the words **perilous and dangerous** are similar in meaning.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Other options are**:

 
 
• **Tremendous- **very great in amount, scale, or intensity.**(जबरदस्त)**
 
• **Loud- **producing or capable of producing much noise.**(तेज आवाज)**
 
• **Nasty- **very bad or unpleasant.**(गंदा)**
